nameJa: 四隅の内側にチャット
conceptNote: 動画の四隅を大きく囲み、その内側にチャットと入力欄を重ねる、機能を直球で伝える図。
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: premium, text-free Chrome Web Store promotional tile for a browser extension that overlays live chat on a fullscreen video.
Create ONE finished landscape design, aspect ratio exactly 11:7 (target 1760 x 1120), with a white background and a large dark ink video surface occupying most of the image. Sophisticated flat editorial graphic design, precise geometry, crisp antialiasing, balanced generous margins, a tiny restrained red accent. This is a functional diagram, not a screenshot or a physical monitor.
Inside the large video surface, place one prominent red rounded rectangle containing a white play triangle, centered in the left two-thirds. On the RIGHT, overlay a slim warm-white live chat panel, only about 27 percent of the fullscreen video width, inset with room around it. Give the chat five comfortably spaced rows of small circular avatar dots and short rounded message strokes of varying lengths, then a compact blank rounded composer at the bottom with a simple right-pointing send triangle. These are pure shapes: absolutely no letters, numbers or pseudo-writing.
The most important visual relationship: the chat is INSIDE the fullscreen video. Four elegant white right-angle fullscreen corner brackets enclose the ENTIRE large dark video surface including the chat. The right-hand top and bottom brackets must sit at the far OUTER RIGHT beyond the chat panel, never on the seam between video and chat. Left and right brackets are aligned to the same complete outer rectangle.
Keep all artwork legible when reduced to 440 x 280. No landscape scenery, no people, no mountains or sun, no browser address bar, no separate sidebar outside the video, no screen bezel, no laptop or physical monitor, no 3D, no glow, no shadows, no gradients, no logos or watermark. No text anywhere.
